Friends of Inishowen Cancer Care Services are holding their AGM at 7.30 p.m in Flat1, Pastoral Centre, Carndonagh , F93XP59 on Wednesday 25th November at 7.30. Everyone is welcome to attend. Youth 2000 Christmas Retreat - 11th-13th December 2026. Calling all young people aged 16 –35! Join us at the Youth 2000 Christmas Retreat in Newbridge College, Co. Kildare. This is a donation-only event, with free buses available across the country and all meals included. Expect inspiring talks and workshops, Mass, music, prayer, and plenty of opportunities to chill out and meet other young Catholics. Whether you are new to the faith or looking to be refreshed, all are welcome. To register or find out more, visit youth2000.ie or follow @Youth2000Ireland. Ballyliffin Oratory, are hosting a visit of A Pilgrim Virgin Statue of Our Lady of Fatima. Tuesday, 24th November at 6pm . Ireland Needs Fatima’s life like statue will be displayed for all to venerate. The Marian Programme features an inspiring presentation on the 1917 Fatima apparitions, followed by a group rosary. Ireland Needs Fatima custodians will be displaying a wide selection of fine religious articles, such as rosaries, medals and books. The All-Night Vigil in Knock celebrating the Feast of the Immaculate Conception takes place on the evening of Monday 7th December. Confession 10pm-Midnight. Beginning at Midnight and continuing through the night with Eucharistic Adoration, the Rosary, Stations of the Cross, reflections and concluding with Mass at 4am on the 8th of December. A Bus will leave Carndonagh at 4pm travelling via Moville-Muff-Bridgend-Letterkenny. Bus is €60 which included tea and evening meal enroute.
